    {"source_unit_id": "P2", "text": "Outside are the fire station and the road corporation situation room; the control operator runs the equipment, and the patrol team handles on-site response."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P3", "text": "At 10:05 a.m., a fire detector detects a temperature of 70 °C at the middle point of the tunnel and sends a fire alarm to the tunnel control room. The tunnel control room confirms a vehicle fire through CCTV footage."},

    {"source_unit_id": "P7", "text": "If the smoke spreads to the evacuation passage, the control operator also lowers the opposite exit barrier. On this day, the smoke did not spread to the evacuation passage, so the opposite exit was left open."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P8", "text": "At 10:25 a.m., the fire station completely extinguishes the fire and notifies the control room of extinguishment completion."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P9", "text": "When extinguishment is complete, the control operator switches the jet fans to ventilation mode, and the patrol team tows the accident vehicle."},
